import re

# Check if DOTALL affects $ behavior

print(f'Match \"test\\n\": {re.match(pattern, \"test\\n\")}')
print(f'Match \"test\\n\" with DOTALL: {re.match(pattern, \"test\\n\", re.DOTALL)}')

# Also check MULTILINE flag
print(f'Match \"test\\n\" with MULTILINE: {re.match(pattern, \"test\\n\", re.MULTILINE)}')
"
